CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION AGENDA
  TUESDAY, OCTOBER 28, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Kevin McGuan, Chair  Jacqueline Padilla-Perez, Commissioner
Mark Grisafe, Vice Chair  Marco Pizzo, Commissioner
Amy Bodek, Commissioner  Jocelynn Pryor, Commissioner
Tasha Hunter, Commissioner

  CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS
  TO CULTURAL.HERITAGE@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 982 3985 6018
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/98239856018

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56823  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56824  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Cultural Heritage Commission
  meeting of Tuesday, August 26, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56829  Recommendation to approve a Major Certificate of Appropriateness request and
  adopt related findings and conditions related thereto, to demolish an existing two-

  car garage and replace with a new 396-square-foot two-car garage on the rear of
  the property and construct a second-story 155-square-foot addition to the main
  residence, and new 481-square-foot replacement patio cover. The property is
  located at 3724 Lewis Avenue, within the California Heights Historic District and
  the existing primary residence is a Non-Contributing Structure in the R-1-N Zoning
  District. (District 5)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56837  Recommendation to approve a Certificate of Appropriateness and adopt the
  proposed findings and conditions of approval thereto, to allow a rooftop addition of
  3,345 square feet, consisting of a trellis covered community garden and accessory
  circulation areas, as well as exterior modifications to the building. These
  improvements are designed to support the adaptive reuse of a 70,146 square foot,
  6 story existing commercial building into 69 dwellings units. Of these units, 11
  percent are designated as very low income and 9 percent are moderate income.
  The property is located at 115 Pine Avenue in the PD-30 Zoning district and is a
  designated Historic Landmark known as First National Bank of Long Beach
  Building (District 1).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Cultural Heritage Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Rosa Garibay, City Clerk Assistant, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
